::: {#def-cross-attention}

#### Cross-attention (encoder-decoder attention)

**Cross-attention** is [scaled dot-product attention](#def-attention) whose queries are computed from one sequence,
and whose keys and values are computed from another.
@vaswani2017attention [section 3.2.3] call it **encoder-decoder attention**,
since its queries come from the network that writes the output
and its keys and values from the network that read the input.

:::
